author: Sarah Jenkins
title: Unforgettable Sunset Desert Safari at Khor Al Adaid!
comment: From our driver picking us up right on time in a pristine Land Cruiser, to the breathtaking sunset over the golden dunes and Inland Sea - everything was world-class. The camel ride, sandboarding, and stargazing atmosphere with Gott Qatar was pure magic.

title: Lusail and Doha City Tour was completely seamless
comment: Our tour guide was knowledgeable and provided deep historical context for Katara Cultural Village, Souq Waqif, and Lusail Marina. Outstanding hospitality and punctuality from Gott Qatar.
